title: Parallel Non-Integer Multiple-Cell-Height Node Remapping
evidence_span: Institutional abstract describes parallel longest-path-first and iterative minimum-slack-first remapping for non-integer multiple-cell-height standard-cell designs.
problem: Exhaustive node and fanin mapping enumeration makes timing-aware remapping expensive for non-integer multiple-cell-height circuits.
method_or_artifact: Timing-critical-node prioritization through parallel longest-path-first and iterative minimum-slack-first remapping schemes.
workload_or_benchmark: Non-integer multiple-cell-height standard-cell designs; named benchmark circuits not established by abstract.
hardware_or_process_assumptions: Compute platform, process library and thread count not specified in abstract.
limits: Reported average speedup withheld until baseline, compute budget and placement-quality criteria are known. Remapping runtime is not end-to-end implementation time or chip performance. No full-manuscript extraction or independent acceptance.

title: Uncertainty-Guided Live Measurement Sequencing for Fast SAR ADC Linearity Testing
evidence_span: Selected original ICCAD preprint: local code-edge sweeps, EKF mismatch estimation, uncertainty-guided selection and residual-triggered covariance inflation; simulated evaluation and overlapping acquisition/selection timing.
problem: Dense acquisition and offline reconstruction increase the cost of SAR ADC linearity testing.
method_or_artifact: Closed-loop selection of code-edge measurements with an Extended Kalman Filter behavioral mismatch model and covariance inflation.
workload_or_benchmark: Simulated 10–18-bit SAR ADCs; statistical experiment on 100 synthetic 16-bit ADCs informed by modified measured-device mismatch data.
hardware_or_process_assumptions: C implementation; acquisition modeled at 1 MS/s; reusable setup excluded from per-device timing; compute-platform conditions unresolved. Not a measured production tester deployment.
baselines: 12-bit reconstruction comparison to ramp histogram testing at 128 hits per code; cross-paper model-driven timing references are not locally matched implementations
limits: Headline timings withheld pending platform/setup accounting and independent review. Fixed-iteration evaluation does not demonstrate adaptive stopping. Noisy small sweeps can diverge temporarily; covariance shrinkage can induce drift. Distinct enhanced follow-up arXiv:2511.11917 is excluded.

evidence_locators.location: arXiv:2511.11895v1, Sections III.E–VI, PDF pages 5–8; visually checked Table I page 7; iccad/data/uglms-primary-recovery-v1.json
